title: Technical English — Course 5, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 6

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the document-applicability lesson begin?
tasks.audioText: The aircraft maintenance instructor will review document applicability on Wednesday at ten. Students should bring the sample aircraft identification record and maintenance task card. The lesson will explain why the aircraft model and serial number must be checked before a task reference is selected. Students will work with controlled training copies only.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which records should students bring?
tasks.audioText: The aircraft maintenance instructor will review document applicability on Wednesday at ten. Students should bring the sample aircraft identification record and maintenance task card. The lesson will explain why the aircraft model and serial number must be checked before a task reference is selected. Students will work with controlled training copies only.
options: The aircraft identification record and maintenance task card

tasks.prompt: Maintenance instructions are applicable only when they match the relevant aircraft or component configuration. Before using a task card, a technician checks the aircraft or component identity, the document reference and its revision status. Similar model names do not guarantee that instructions are interchangeable. If applicability is uncertain, the issue should be referred to the authorised technical publications process. Reading 1. What should be checked before a task card is used?
options: Aircraft or component identity, document reference and revision status

tasks.prompt: What should happen if applicability is uncertain?
options: Refer the issue through the authorised technical publications process

tasks.prompt: The document revision ___ before the task card is used.
Choose TWO checks needed before using a maintenance task card.
The condition of being relevant to a particular aircraft or component is document ___.
The task card may refer to a different aircraft configuration. What should you ask?
options: Could we confirm the correct task applicability against the aircraft identification and approved publications?
I will copy an unrelated record.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of aircraft maintenance documentation in a logical order.
Write 80–100 words explaining why aircraft identity, configuration and document revision must be checked before maintenance instructions are used.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: task completion and relevant content (0–2); clear organisation and logical linking (0–2); grammar and sentence structure (0–2); accurate maintenance and quality vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2).
